arguments.summary: The failed jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing due to an issue with the pgbouncer service, which caused connection timeouts. The cause of the timeouts is currently under investigation, but it is suspected that the disk may be full. Additionally, a review of the pgbouncer service revealed that it is the Postgres server itself, and its CPU graph represents the database CPU. The failed jobs table has been exported using pg_dump as per P17's instructions to facilitate the postmortem analysis.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the disk usage of the pgbouncer service to ensure it does not reach its limit. Restart the pgbouncer service if necessary to clear any connection issues. Once the root cause of the timeouts is identified, implement a solution to prevent similar issues in the future. Continue monitoring the failed jobs backlog and take action to resolve any pending jobs.
